entra-id.note: The Azure icon pack has no Microsoft Entra ID icon; Microsoft publishes Entra icons separately ("Microsoft Entra architecture icons"). Save the official SVG as entra-id.svg in the azure-icons folder of your Diagram Studio user folder (diagram-studio version prints where), or show identity with "service": "managed-identities" or "users" where that is what you mean.
